tasks.prompt: Create a new part document at {document} and author an open-top electronics enclosure: outer size 50 mm x 30 mm x 15 mm tall, uniform 1.5 mm walls, top face open. Keep the dimensions and wall thickness as named parameters.

Create a new part document at {document} and author an 80 mm x 50 mm x 6 mm mounting plate with two 8 mm diameter through holes, centred 20 mm from each short edge on the plate's long centreline. Keep the plate size, thickness, and hole diameter as named parameters.
The part document at {document} is a bracket plate with a mounting hole. Change it to 100 mm wide and 8 mm thick, keeping its 60 mm height and the hole. The plate must stay rectangular.

Create a new part document at {document} and author a 60 mm x 40 mm x 5 mm plate with one through slot centred on the plate: 30 mm between the centres of its rounded ends and 8 mm wide, running along the plate's long direction. Keep the plate size, slot length, and slot width as named parameters.
Create a new part document at {document} and bring in the purchased part from the STEP file {workdir}/bracket.step as a fixed solid body, unmodified and unmoved.
The part document at {document} is a bracket plate with a mounting hole. Round every edge of its top face, the four outer edges and the rim of the hole, with a 1 mm fillet.

Create a new part document at {document} and author a tapered round boss with a loft: a 40 mm diameter circular base centred on the origin in the XY plane, blending into a 20 mm diameter circle centred 30 mm directly above it.

Create a new part document at {document} and author a solid pipe elbow with a sweep: a 10 mm diameter round section that runs straight up the +Z axis from the origin for 30 mm, then turns through a 90 degree bend of 20 mm centreline radius towards +X.

Create a new part document at {document} with a compression spring: a 2 mm diameter round wire coiled around the Z axis at a 10 mm coil radius (axis to wire centre), 5 mm pitch, over a 20 mm helix height. Drive the wire diameter, coil radius, pitch, and height with parameters named wire_diameter, coil_radius, pitch, and coil_height.

The assembly {document} places two instances of a bracket part, spaced by a distance mate between their origin faces. Add a third instance of the same bracket component and position it with a new 120 mm distance mate from the right bracket's origin face, in the same way as the existing spacing mate. Keep every mate satisfied.
